related.title: LAPACK DSGESV：混合精度迭代修正
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付V-cycle圖、收縮序列與跨層邊界檢查；.0016/.0256可重算，實際逐輪q若變動則撤回固定q預測；請另一位學徒依交付件重新推導一組；未通過或資料不足必須明記，不以品牌或峰值取代證據。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver V-cycle diagrams, contraction sequences, and cross-level boundary checks. Reproduce 0.0016 and 0.0256. Withdraw constant-q predictions if observed contraction changes. Have another learner derive one case from the handover; label failures or missing evidence without substituting brand names or peak rates.
related.difference: 畫初解→高精度殘差→低精度修正解→更新迴圈；註記本紙面例未模擬全部浮點捨入；兩δ值相符且更新解滿足原方程；報告明列精確紙面近似。
related.differenceEn: Draw the initial solve, higher-precision residual, correction solve, and update. State that the paper example omits floating-point rounding. Both corrections must match and satisfy the original equation. Identify the exact-arithmetic assumption.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 假設每V-cycle使殘差乘q，k輪後r_k=r0q^k；固定q是教學近似而非普遍保證；合成r0=1、q=.2、k4；另一平滑器q=.4，其餘相同；名義式 1*.2**4 = 0.0016 residual norm model；變更式 1*.4**4 = 0.0256 residual norm model。數據與驗收門檻為原創教學情境，並非所列超級電腦或函式庫的實測規格。

對Ax=b，r=b−Ax、解Aδ=r再更新x+δ；殘差計算精度與修正精度需分欄；合成A3、b1，初值x=.3；另一初值.32，修正方程先以精確紙面算；名義式 (1-3*.3)/3 = 0.0333333333333 correction delta；變更式 (1-3*.32)/3 = 0.0133333333333 correction delta。數據與驗收門檻為原創教學情境，並非所列超級電腦或函式庫的實測規格。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: If each V-cycle multiplies the residual by q, then r_k = r0 q^k. Constant q is a teaching approximation, not a universal guarantee. Synthetic r0 = 1, q = 0.2, and k = 4; compare a smoother with q = 0.4. Nominal 1*.2**4 = 0.0016 residual norm model; changed 1*.4**4 = 0.0256 residual norm model. Inputs and acceptance thresholds are original teaching scenarios, not measured specifications of the named systems or libraries.

For Ax = b, form r = b − Ax, solve Aδ = r, and update x + δ. Record residual and correction precisions separately. Synthetic A = 3, b = 1, initial x = 0.3 versus 0.32. Solve the correction exactly on paper. Nominal (1-3*.3)/3 = 0.0333333333333 correction delta; changed (1-3*.32)/3 = 0.0133333333333 correction delta. Inputs and acceptance thresholds are original teaching scenarios, not measured specifications of the named systems or libraries.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.differenceEn: Draw fixed grid size with varying P. Tabulate TP, S, E, and P×TP separately. Reproduce both efficiencies with fixed work. Distinguish speedup, efficiency, and resource-time units.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。

S(P)=T1/TP，E=S/P；必須同一問題、正確性與計時邊界；合成T1=120秒，P4時TP36秒，P8時TP22秒；名義式 120/36/4 = 0.833333333333 parallel efficiency；變更式 120/22/8 = 0.681818181818 parallel efficiency。數據與驗收門檻為原創教學情境，並非所列超級電腦或函式庫的實測規格。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。

Synthetic r0 = 1, q = 0.2, and k = 4; compare a smoother with q = 0.4. Nominal 1*.2**4 = 0.0016 residual norm model; changed 1*.4**4 = 0.0256 residual norm model. Inputs and acceptance thresholds are original teaching scenarios, not measured specifications of the named systems or libraries.

S(P) = T1/TP and E = S/P require the same problem, correctness criterion, and timing boundaries. Synthetic T1 = 120 seconds, TP = 36 at P = 4, and TP = 22 at P = 8. Nominal 120/36/4 = 0.833333333333 parallel efficiency; changed 120/22/8 = 0.681818181818 parallel efficiency. Inputs and acceptance thresholds are original teaching scenarios, not measured specifications of the named systems or libraries.
